"''Your problems are not my problems.|Cort and a customer||audio=YourProblems.mp3}} During the [[Imperial Era]], a [[Color|green]]-skinned '''Rodian''' with violet-to-bright-cyan [[eye]]s attempted to leave a [[Unidentified desert town|desert town]] on an [[Unidentified astronomical object (Cort)|astronomical object]]. To this end, he visited a [[Cort's transport office|transport office]], carrying a casket adorned with the [[Imperial crest]] under his arm. At the entrance, he checked in by scanning his card on a reader held by [[Asajj Ventress]], the former lead [[assassin]] of [[Count]] [[Dooku]]. After checking in, the [[Rodian]] approached the counter, where a [[Gender|woman]] named [[Cort]] was seated. Since he lacked a valid ticket, Cort refused to grant him passage, even after he revealed he had no [[Currency|money]]. In response to this refusal, the Rodian drew a [[X-8 Night Sniper]] and aimed it at the [[clerk]], insisting he needed to get out. Before he could fire a shot, Ventress intervened by parrying his gun and tossing him out of the office. ==Behind the scenes== The [[Rodian]] debuted in "[[A Way Forward]]," the first episode of the series ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Underworld]]'', which premiered on [[May 4]], [[2025]], on [[Disney+]],{{SWYouTube|GkywNANueew|Tales of the Underworld | Official Trailer | Available May 4 on Disney+}} with a pre-release [[May 2|two days earlier]] in the video game ''[[Fortnite]]''.{{Fortnite|url=news/get-a-new-stormtrooper-in-fortnite-and-watch-two-episodes-of-star-wars-tales-of-the-underworld|text=Get a New Stormtrooper in Fortnite & Watch Two Episodes of Star Wars: Tales of the Underworld!}} ==Appearances== *{{TOTU|A Way Forward}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=გადამყვანების ოფისის უცნობი როდიანი კლიენტი }} [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Rodians]]
